'''Plan Bastion''' was a protocol initiated by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]] aboard his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] after it was boarded by a party of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that included [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker]], [[Ben Skywalker]], and [[Saba Sebatyne]]. The protocol involved the strategic placing of security teams, the closing of [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]], and the deployment of [[YVH-Series battle droid]]s, all of which Caedus hoped would reduce the number of Jedi attacking him, although he did not believe the measures would be enough to actually defeat them.<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>
